answer: Continuous Spectrum Capture. Each agent must submit a live optical reading of a crystal wafer whose doping varies per unit; the measured pigment spectrum is checked against the wafer’s pulse-timed challenge. A single operator can buy many wafers, but each valid identity demands one physically distinct wafer held by one device during challenge, so cloning requires procuring and maintaining separate hardware per identity. Marginal cost per fake identity equals wafer fabrication plus device custody, not registration.
